title: Normalized Event
description: A raw telemetry event after parsing, normalization, and enrichment. What the correlation engine evaluates against. Always linked back to its raw form for lineage.

ingested_at.description: Used to compute ingestion/collection lag in the SOC pipeline-latency KPI.

event_type.description: e.g. 'windows_security_4624', 'firewall_deny', 'cloud_iam_policy_change'. Free text, seeded per source family.

attack_technique_refs.description: Optional pre-tagging at the event level (some sources tag natively). Correlation may inherit or confirm this tagging when producing an alert's attack_techniques.

raw_payload_ref.description: Pointer to the preserved original raw event for lineage.
